notes: Ships year-only. Month and week are HELD (see style notes) for the image pass on the page's data-plate image Unico-style-1.jpg, which colors year/month/week but cannot be read by text fetch. Page states subsidiaries/related brands: none noted, so no sister claim and no usesStylesOf.

styles.notes: Month HELD (flagged judgment): the page states month from the '4th & 5th positions', but that yields '3A' under character counting and '31' under digit-only counting, both invalid as months, so both sanctioned readings are falsified by the page's own example. A month of 03 would require counting positions in the page's spaced display '06 03A184624' (space counted as a position), which is not a page-stated counting rule, so it is NOT encoded. Week HELD: the legend mentions week (BLUE) but the text states no week rule or positions. Year ships: page states year from the 1st & 2nd positions; the example's leading '06' resolves to 2006 under the century rule (1906 is below the 1960 floor). Year value is derived from the stated positions, not page-stated.
